answer: In the "onyx" phase, each vault linked to an operator's identity holds one voting token, ensuring one-vote-per-vault. Fake identities must burn one coin per epoch to maintain existence, with costs linearly increasing per additional vault. The "oasis" network detects anomalies by monitoring vault activity and linking suspicious identities to a common operator. This enforces the "summit" consensus rule, making sybil attacks prohibitively expensive for attackers while allowing honest agents to operate at a flat fee.
